source_all_pass_gate: Every one of the ten frozen Coinbase half-year requests returns no more than 300 rows and contains every complete UTC day inside its exact partition.
Every Binance BTCUSDT monthly ZIP from 2020-01 through 2024-12 exists, matches its publisher checksum and contains one exact complete-day CSV member.
Both venues contain one finite positive close for every UTC day from 2020-01-01 through 2024-12-31, with no duplicate or repaired day.
Two create-only source executions must produce byte-identical bundle and normalized-gzip hashes.

all_pass_predictive_gates: Design and Validation each contain at least 120 positive-premium and 120 negative-or-zero-premium next-day outcomes.
Positive-premium mean next-day BTC open-to-open return exceeds negative-or-zero-premium mean in both Design and Validation.
Validation positive-premium downside semideviation is no worse than negative-or-zero-premium downside semideviation.
Positive-minus-negative-or-zero annual mean next-day return is positive in at least three of 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024.
No single positive annual delta supplies more than 60 percent of total positive annual delta.

stop_conditions: Stop DATA_REJECT before premium computation on any source transport, schema, timestamp, partition, checksum, common-day, duplicate, nonpositive-close or determinism failure.
Do not repair a day, poll an authenticated endpoint, add retries, change venue, pair, date range or quote conversion, or infer a missing close.
After source value access, do not change the natural zero threshold, direction, next-day mapping, window, gate, cost or comparator and do not add smoothing, volume, stablecoin or regime conditions.
If any frozen predictive gate fails, close before matched-capital economics, prohibit reverse mapping and keep OOS sealed.
scope_note: Frozen free price-only source and downstream predictive preregistration before any Coinbase or Binance close value access for this family. No candle response, close, premium, return, factor, strategy, PnL, drawdown, candidate, OOS, paid API, key, second timer, second writer, canonical write, Production, Trading, database, order, fund, OCO, Grid, SHADOW, PAPER or LIVE action occurred.
